vocabulary.meaning_en: the place where an event, meeting or party happens
vocabulary.example: The hotel is a good venue for our conference.

vocabulary.meaning_en: whether something is free to use or book
vocabulary.example: Could I check availability for next Tuesday?

vocabulary.meaning_en: to arrange to use a room, seat or service at a future time
vocabulary.example: I booked a meeting room for 10 o'clock.

vocabulary.meaning_en: equipment for work, such as Wi-Fi, a projector or a printer
vocabulary.example: The hotel has excellent business facilities.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a large room for meetings
vocabulary.example: The conference room can hold fifty people.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to have space for a number of people
vocabulary.example: How many people can this room hold?

vocabulary.meaning_en: food and drink given to guests at an event
vocabulary.example: Hospitality includes tea, coffee and sandwiches.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a machine that shows pictures or slides on a wall or screen
vocabulary.example: Please connect your laptop to the projector.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to connect a machine to the electricity or another machine
vocabulary.example: Is there somewhere to plug in my laptop?

vocabulary.meaning_en: with very little time to prepare
vocabulary.meaning_ar: في وقت قصير؛ دون إشعار مسبق كافٍ
vocabulary.example: It's hard to find a venue at short notice.

vocabulary.meaning_en: advice about what is good to choose
vocabulary.example: Do you have any recommendations for a good hotel?

vocabulary.meaning_en: a letter or message that asks someone to come to an event
vocabulary.example: We sent invitations to all our clients.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a document that shows how much money you must pay
vocabulary.example: Please send us an invoice and we'll pay this week.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to add something extra for free
vocabulary.example: If you book the room, we'll throw in free coffee.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to have a very difficult job to do
vocabulary.example: With only two days left, we have our work cut out.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to finish a piece of work quickly
vocabulary.example: Can you turn this report round by Friday?

vocabulary.meaning_en: to try something
vocabulary.example: I've never organised a launch, but I'll give it a go.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to be liked by people
vocabulary.example: The new menu went down well with our guests.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to fit people or things into a small space or time
vocabulary.example: We can squeeze in two more chairs.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a business agreement, often with a good price
vocabulary.example: She gave us a good deal on the room.

vocabulary.meaning_en: money that is paid
vocabulary.example: We'll sort out payment as soon as possible.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to paint a room or make it look nice
vocabulary.example: The conference room is being decorated this week.

fine_lines.title: invite vs invitation
fine_lines.explanation_ar: invite فعل معناه «يدعو»، وinvitation اسم معناه «دعوة». في الكلام غير الرسمي يستخدم الناس invite اسمًا أيضًا، لكن في العمل الأفضل invitation.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Invite is the verb; invitation is the noun. In casual speech people say 'an invite', but in business writing use 'invitation'.

examples.sentence: We will invite all our clients.
Did you receive the invitation to the launch?

fine_lines.title: throw vs throw in
fine_lines.explanation_ar: throw وحدها تعني «يرمي» شيئًا بيده. أما throw in في سياق البيع فتعني «يضيف شيئًا مجانًا». لذلك أخطأت آنا في الحلقة حين ظنّت أن الطعام سيُرمى!
fine_lines.explanation_en: Throw means to send something through the air with your hand. Throw in (in business) means add something extra for free. Anna thought the food would be thrown - a funny mistake!

examples.sentence: Please don't throw the ball in the office.
If you buy two, we'll throw in a third one free.

expressions.phrase: Could I check availability for your venue, please?
expressions.meaning_ar: هل يمكنني الاستفسار عن توفّر القاعة لديكم من فضلك؟
expressions.meaning_en: Is your venue free on the date I need?
expressions.example: Could I check availability for your venue on the 3rd of May, please?

expressions.phrase: What business facilities do you have?
expressions.meaning_ar: ما التجهيزات الخاصة بالأعمال المتوفرة لديكم؟
expressions.meaning_en: What equipment for work does the venue have?
expressions.example: What business facilities do you have? We need Wi-Fi and a projector.

expressions.phrase: How many people can the room hold?
expressions.example: How many people can the room hold? We're expecting forty guests.

expressions.meaning_en: Can you give our guests food and drink?
expressions.example: Can you provide hospitality, such as tea and sandwiches?
How much does it cost to book the room for two hours?

expressions.phrase: If you can send us an invoice, we'll sort payment out as soon as possible.
expressions.meaning_ar: إذا أرسلتم لنا فاتورة فسنسدّد المبلغ في أقرب وقت ممكن.
expressions.meaning_en: Send the bill and we will pay quickly.
expressions.example: Thank you. If you can send us an invoice, we'll sort payment out as soon as possible.

expressions.phrase: If I can help in any way, just let me know.
expressions.meaning_ar: إن كان بإمكاني المساعدة بأي شكل، فأخبرني فقط.
expressions.example: That sounds like a lot of work. If I can help in any way, just let me know.
I'm not sure I can finish by Friday, but I'll give it a go.

grammar.title: Asking for information politely: Could I…? / Can you…? / How many…? / How much…?
grammar.explanation_ar: عند الاتصال لحجز مكان نسأل بأسئلة واضحة: Could I + فعل (أكثر تهذيبًا)، Can you + فعل، How many + اسم جمع + can…، How much does it cost? لاحظ أن الفعل يبقى في المصدر بعد can/could، ونستخدم does مع it في المضارع.
grammar.explanation_en: To ask about a venue, use clear questions: Could I + verb (very polite), Can you + verb, How many + plural noun + can..., How much does it cost? After can/could use the base verb; use 'does' with 'it' in the present simple.
examples: Could I check availability for Friday?
Can you provide lunch for twenty people?
How many people can the hall hold?
How much does it cost per day?

grammar.title: First conditional for arrangements: If you…, we'll…
grammar.explanation_ar: لنعرض أو نتفق على خطوة مستقبلية نستخدم الشرط الأول: If + مضارع بسيط، will + فعل. مثال: If you send an invoice, we'll pay.
grammar.explanation_en: To agree on a future action, use the first conditional: If + present simple, will + verb.
examples: If you send us an invoice, we'll pay this week.
If you book today, we'll throw in free coffee.
If the room is free, we'll take it.

questions.question: What is a 'venue'?
choices: a place where an event happens
questions.explanation_ar: venue هو المكان الذي تُقام فيه الفعالية.
questions.explanation_en: A venue is the place where an event takes place.

questions.question: How many people can the room ___?
'Hospitality' at an event means…
questions.explanation_ar: hospitality تعني الضيافة من طعام وشراب.
questions.explanation_en: Hospitality is food and drink for guests.

questions.question: Marge says she will 'throw in' the food. She means she will…
choices: sell the food at a high price
questions.explanation_ar: throw in تعني إضافة الشيء مجانًا.
questions.explanation_en: 'Throw in' means add it for free.

questions.question: Which question is correct?
questions.explanation_ar: مع does يبقى الفعل في المصدر: does it cost.
questions.explanation_en: After 'does', use the base verb: 'does it cost'.

questions.question: 'At short notice' means…
choices: with a long time to plan
with very little time to prepare
questions.explanation_ar: at short notice أي في وقت قصير دون استعداد كافٍ.
questions.explanation_en: At short notice = with little time to prepare.

questions.question: If you send us an invoice, we ___ payment out quickly.
questions.explanation_ar: الشرط الأول: If + مضارع، will + فعل.
questions.explanation_en: First conditional: If + present, will + verb.

questions.question: Wi-Fi, a projector and a place to plug in your laptop are…
'You have your work cut out' means…
choices: you have a difficult job to do
questions.explanation_ar: have your work cut out تعني أن أمامك مهمة صعبة.
questions.explanation_en: It means you have a difficult job to do.

questions.question: Which word is the noun?
questions.explanation_ar: invitation هو الاسم، وinvite هو الفعل.
